messages:
zoe: Hey everyone — I'm Zoe (infra, started today). Trying to get Console admin access for staging and prod + feature-flag admin. In Okta I only see `Console (reader)`. What's the standard flow?

sam: welcome Zoe :tada: For staging it's self-serve: go to Okta > Applications > request 'console-admin-staging' group. If that option is missing open an ENG-IT ticket and tag me. Prod is gated (manager + security review). DM me your manager and I'll start the staging grant now.

maria: +1. Also make sure you’ve completed the "Data & Prod Access" training (People Ops portal). Prod admin role = `console-admin`. Feature flag admin = `flags-admin` in LaunchDarkly.

zoe: I did the training yesterday. How do I request LaunchDarkly rights?

ld-admin: Ping @sam with your LaunchDarkly username. We need a short justification and an expiry date (default 30 days for new hires). Example: “Project: infra rollout; Need: enable/disable infra flags for blue/green; Expiry: 2024-08-15”.

henry: If you'll be toggling flags that affect traffic, include a rollout/rollback plan in the ticket. Also prefer canary changes and set an immediate kill-switch flag.

zoe: Can you paste a ticket template I can reuse?

sam: Sure — copy this into ENG-IT: 

Request: console-admin-prod and flags-admin (LaunchDarkly)
Reason: <brief purpose>
Manager: <manager name>
Requested expiry: <YYYY-MM-DD>
Flags: <flag1, flag2>
Rollout plan: <canary %, metrics to watch, rollback criteria>

maria: Small tip: to preview a flag locally you can use the internal CLI: 

```
rdwctl flags get my_flag --env=staging --whoami
```

onboarding-bot: Reminder: new hires — enable 2FA and register your YubiKey for prod admin requests. Link: https://okta.redwood/setup-2fa

security-bot: Note: Prod admin grants are audited weekly. Please include ticket number and justify access scope (least privilege). Security will run the access checklist after approval.

zoe: Awesome, this helps a lot. I'll open the ENG-IT ticket now and ping @sam. Thanks all! :heart:
